description: This file defines the ApiError class, which extends the standard Error class to create a standardized way to handle HTTP error responses in an API context. It includes customization for status code, message, and optional debug details.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: A custom error class for representing API errors with HTTP status codes and optional debugging details.

methods.name: constructor(statusCode, message, details = undefined)
methods.description: Initializes a new ApiError with a status code, message, and optional additional details, capturing the stack trace for debugging.
